item.title: Shapeshifter
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Phi Age
  • 発売日: 2010-01-29
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シェイプシフター
  • 英語名: Shapeshifter

あらすじ

Yuuma is caught in a fierce battle and a pretty girl comes to his aid. Her name is Natia and she intends to protect him and the town from destruction. He greatly wishes to be able to help her, and that’s when a bright light envelops them and Natia’s weapon transforms into a giant sword. So a normal boy will become the key to saving the world… no, the universe!

item.title: Owarinaki Natsu, Towa Naru Shirabe
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Phi Age
  • 発売日: 2009-07-24
  • スコア: 7.4/10 (45 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 終わりなき夏 永遠なる音律
  • 英語名: Owarinaki Natsu, Towa Naru Shirabe

别名

  • おわりなきなつ とわなるしらべ

あらすじ

In Kyushu, there lies the small village of Suno. In that small village, four childhood friends, Touma Takumi, Ogami Ritsuko, Amamiya Kanon, and Takanashi Mio comprise a small music club at the village school. One day, Takumi happens to see and hear the violin performance of Orihara Ai, a girl who recently moved to the village and transferred into the school. This performance later eventually causes Ritsuko to resolve to recruit Ai into their music club no matter what.
